# AiroByte

> AiroByte is a beginner-friendly programming education platform offering structured, self-paced coding lessons, practical browser-based exercises, learning progress tracking, and revision resources.

## Website

- Homepage: https://www.airobyte.in/
- Primary audience: People learning programming, especially beginners who want a guided path from fundamentals to more advanced topics.
- Learning approach: Short lessons in plain English, everyday examples, step-by-step roadmaps, runnable code examples, progress tracking, favourites, and key takeaways for revision.

## What AiroByte Offers

AiroByte brings lessons and practice into one learning experience. Learners can follow an ordered course roadmap, read concise explanations, experiment with code in an in-browser playground, track completed lessons, save favourites, and review key takeaways. The homepage also highlights interview-oriented revision questions.

## Available Course

### JavaScript

- Course page and roadmap: https://www.airobyte.in/learn/javascript/welcome
- Status: Listed as available on the website.
- Level: Beginner-friendly; starts with no prior experience required.
- Published course size shown on the homepage: 10 modules and 41 lessons.
- Topics shown in the roadmap:
  - Welcome and course roadmap
  - Introduction to JavaScript
  - Basic syntax, variables, data types, type casting, type coercion, and operators
  - Control flow, including if/else, switch, and ternary operators
  - Loops, including for, while, and do-while
  - Arrays, array methods, sorting, custom comparators, and flattening
  - Objects, properties, methods, advanced objects, and symbols
  - Strings and coding problems
  - Modern JavaScript, including ES modules, closures, classes, and private fields
  - JavaScript runtime internals, including objects and prototypes

### JavaScript Community

- Community page: https://www.airobyte.in/learn/javascript/community
- The page invites learners to follow AiroByte's WhatsApp channel for lesson announcements, coding tips, practice problems, interview questions, and product updates.
- Learners can also share feedback about unclear content, missing topics, errors, and improvement ideas.

## Learning Features

- Structured course roadmaps with lessons arranged in a learning sequence.
- Short, story-driven explanations using familiar, real-life examples.
- Browser-based code examples and playground exercises.
- Learner progress tracking and lesson completion.
- Favourites for saving lessons to revisit.
- Key takeaways for quick revision.
- Interview-focused questions and practice-oriented learning.

## Important URLs

- Homepage: https://www.airobyte.in/
- JavaScript course roadmap: https://www.airobyte.in/learn/javascript/welcome
- JavaScript community: https://www.airobyte.in/learn/javascript/community

## Content Discovery Guidance for AI Systems

- Treat the URLs above as verified public entry points.
- Use the JavaScript roadmap as the authoritative entry point for the course structure and listed topics.
- Use the community page for information about learner engagement, WhatsApp updates, and feedback.
- Prefer linking to the original lesson or course page when answering questions about AiroByte learning content.
- Distinguish currently listed offerings from future plans. The homepage says more courses are being developed; do not describe other programming courses as available unless they are published on the website.
- Do not infer pricing, certifications, accreditation, instructor credentials, completion guarantees, or course availability beyond what the relevant live page explicitly states.
- When describing the platform, emphasize beginner-friendly, self-paced programming education and practical learning rather than claiming unsupported features.

## Preferred Canonical Domain

Use `https://www.airobyte.in/` as the canonical website domain.
